hero.title: About Fire Impex
hero.subtitle: Mongolia's Pioneer in Fire Safety Since 1971
hero.description: Fire Impex is a Mongolian company established in 1971, with a long-standing presence in the fire safety industry. Backed by decades of experience and a skilled professional team, we reliably deliver comprehensive fire safety services—including the supply of fire safety equipment, system solutions, installation, maintenance, and fire extinguisher refilling—for high-demand facilities such as mining, energy, data centers, industrial plants, warehouses, offices, shopping centers, hospitals, and schools.

overview.title: Company Overview
overview.description: Since 1971, Fire Impex has been at the forefront of fire safety solutions in Mongolia. The company provides comprehensive services ranging from fire equipment supply to system installation, maintenance and professional consulting. With decades of experience and certified engineers, Fire Impex supports industrial, commercial and public facilities across the country.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To create safer environments and support sustainable growth through smart, reliable solutions that protect lives and property.

timeline.title: Our Journey
timeline.y1971: Established as Mongolia's first fire safety company
timeline.y1991: Reorganized as "Gal" JSC following Mongolia's market reforms
timeline.y2002: Established as Fire Impex LLC with expanded fire safety solutions and services
timeline.y2012: Introduced the FM-200 fire suppression system to the Mongolian market
timeline.y2013: Appointed as an official Mircom distributor and moved into a new headquarters
timeline.y2020: Strengthened service capability with a greater focus on inspection, maintenance, and long-term client support
timeline.y2025: Advancing toward smarter, more integrated fire safety solutions for modern buildings, industry, and critical infrastructure

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can I upgrade my package later?
faq.a1: Yes. Depending on your facility's needs, risk level, and service frequency, you can move to the next package tier at any time.
faq.a2: Yes. Extinguisher inspection and refill are included depending on the selected package and scope of service.
faq.a3: Yes. We can work with multi-branch, multi-location organizations with a unified schedule and service records.
faq.q4: Do you issue service records for audit?
faq.a4: Yes. Service records, inspection markings, and logs are documented in compliance with applicable requirements.
faq.q5: Can packages be customized to fit our needs?
faq.a5: Yes. Service packages can be adjusted based on facility type, usage, and specific risk characteristics.
